name: vwap_cross_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, after the index has traded below VWAP for 5+ minutes (60+ bars at 5-second frequency), VWAP-benchmarked buy-side algorithms have accumulated underperformance vs their benchmark and are waiting to reset. When NIFTY's close crosses above VWAP on elevated volume (>1.5x 10-minute average) and the bar closes in the top 30% of its range, these algorithms interpret the cross as a regime confirmation and shift from passive accumulation to active bidding. The resulting institutional buy cohort, amplified by momentum algos triggering on the VWAP reclaim event, drives a 15-25 spot point continuation over the next 60-90 seconds before the new regime is fully absorbed.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(typical_price * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset at 09:15 each session
indicators.purpose: Cumulative measure — no scaling. Session VWAP is the institutional benchmark; the cross event is the primary signal trigger. Does not need period adjustment regardless of bar size.

indicators.name: bars_below_vwap
indicators.formula: consecutive count of 5-second bars where close < vwap, reset at session open or when condition breaks
indicators.purpose: Dwell filter set at 60 bars (5 minutes). Original used 20 bars on 1-min bars = 20 minutes of dwell. On NIFTY's deep liquidity, a 5-minute dwell establishes clear benchmark underperformance — index regime shifts occur faster than individual stocks due to continuous institutional rebalancing. The original 20-minute requirement was necessary for single stocks where VWAP noise is higher.

indicators.name: bars_above_vwap
indicators.formula: consecutive count of 5-second bars where close > vwap, reset at session open or when condition breaks
indicators.purpose: Mirror of bars_below_vwap for bearish VWAP cross signals. Same 60-bar minimum dwell rationale.

indicators.name: vol_sma_120
indicators.purpose: 10-minute rolling volume average (120 bars × 5-sec). Original used SMA(volume, 10) on 1-min bars = same 10-minute history. The 12x scaling is correct here: we need the identical clock-time baseline (10 min) to normalize index volume — the context window purpose is unchanged, only the bar count differs.

indicators.name: volume_surge
indicators.purpose: Identifies cross bars with anomalous institutional participation. Threshold lowered to 1.5x (from original 2.0x) because index volume is noisier at 5-second resolution — genuine institutional flow on NIFTY cross events runs 1.5-2.0x average, not the 2.0-3.0x spikes seen on individual stock events.

indicators.name: ema_12
indicators.purpose: 1-minute EMA (12 bars × 5-sec) for fast momentum direction confirmation. Original used EMA(5) on 1-min = 5-minute trend. Compressed to 1 minute because for a 15-120 second hold, a 5-min EMA is too slow to reflect current micro-momentum at entry; the 1-min EMA aligns with our hold horizon.

indicators.name: bar_range_ratio
indicators.purpose: Measures close position within the 5-second bar's range. A bullish cross bar closing in the top 30% (>0.70) signals conviction buying absorbed intrabar selling; a wick-heavy close near 0.50 indicates VWAP acted as resistance, not support, and the cross lacks follow-through.

conditions: close >= vwap (current bar closes at or above VWAP — the cross)
close[t-1] < vwap[t-1] (previous bar was strictly below VWAP)
bars_below_vwap >= 60 (5+ minutes of continuous dwell below VWAP before the cross)
volume_surge >= 1.5 (cross bar volume is 1.5x the 10-minute average)
bar_range_ratio >= 0.70 (cross bar closes in top 30% of its range)
ema_12[t] > ema_12[t-1] (1-minute EMA rising, momentum aligned)
buy_ce.confirmation: All 6 conditions simultaneous on the same 5-second bar

conditions: close <= vwap (current bar closes at or below VWAP — the cross)
close[t-1] > vwap[t-1] (previous bar was strictly above VWAP)
bars_above_vwap >= 60 (5+ minutes of continuous dwell above VWAP before the cross)
volume_surge >= 1.5 (cross bar volume is 1.5x the 10-minute average)
bar_range_ratio <= 0.30 (cross bar closes in bottom 30% of its range)
ema_12[t] < ema_12[t-1] (1-minute EMA falling, momentum aligned)
buy_pe.confirmation: All 6 conditions simultaneous on the same 5-second bar

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts (~8 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). A genuine VWAP reclaim should not see NIFTY return below VWAP within 90 seconds — institutional buying absorbs immediate selling. An 8 spot pt pullback signals the cross was a false breakout; typical NIFTY 30-second moves are 2-5 pts so 4 option pts allows one normal adverse wiggle before cutting.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts (~14 NIFTY spot pts). VWAP cross momentum bursts on NIFTY extend 15-25 spot pts over 60-90 seconds as the algorithm cohort resets their benchmark positions. Targeting 14 spot pts captures ~60-70% of the median move at 1:1.75 risk-reward, consistent with typical 1-2 minute NIFTY moves of 5-10 option pts.

filters.vix_filter: none — VWAP cross momentum works across VIX regimes; the dwell filter and volume surge requirement already ensure high-conviction entries without needing a VIX regime gate
filters.time_filter: 09:30-15:20 IST (09:30 start allows 15 minutes for session VWAP to stabilize post-open; 15:20 avoids EOD dislocation and final-hour erratic crosses)
filters.volume_filter: volume_surge >= 1.5x 10-minute SMA on the cross bar
filters.trend_filter: ema_12 direction must align with the cross direction (rising for buy_ce, falling for buy_pe)
filters.spread_filter: none (limit orders at candle close price)

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — VWAP cross is widely watched, but the 5-minute dwell filter and simultaneous volume + range-ratio requirements narrow entries to high-conviction crosses missed by participants using simple VWAP cross alerts

adaptation_notes: Three substantive changes from the original: (1) Dwell time compressed from 20 min (20 bars × 1-min) to 5 min (60 bars × 5-sec) — NIFTY's liquidity means benchmark deviation regimes shift faster than individual stocks, and the choppier single-stock VWAP behavior that necessitated 20-min dwell is absent on the index. (2) Volume surge threshold lowered from 2.0x to 1.5x — index volume at 5-second resolution has higher baseline noise, and genuine cross-bar institutional participation on NIFTY runs 1.5-2.0x average rather than the 2.0-3.0x spikes on single stock events. (3) EMA compressed from EMA(5) on 1-min (5-min trend) to EMA(12) on 5-sec (1-min trend) — at 15-120 second hold horizons, the momentum confirmation filter must reflect direction over ~1 minute not 5 minutes. Volume baseline window (10 min) is preserved exactly via 12x bar-count scaling.
weaknesses: On range-bound NIFTY days (pre-RBI policy, expiry morning consolidation), VWAP crosses repeatedly with low follow-through — the 5-min dwell filter reduces but does not eliminate false signals
The 5-second bar_range_ratio filter can be gamed by a single algorithmic print at bar close, producing a false conviction read on a small-range bar
The 60-bar minimum dwell means missing the first VWAP cross of the session, which is statistically the highest-conviction cross of the day

_source.original_stop: VWAP re-cross OR 0.25% from entry, trailing at 0.15% once >0.25% profit
